pattern: reply read aloud has no <speak> summary
experience: With replies read aloud, the voice read the whole markdown reply, backticks and file paths included, because the agent never wrote a <speak> block.
rule: End your reply with a <speak>…</speak> block holding one or two plain sentences. No markdown, code, file paths, or URLs inside it.
prompt: What does reconnectDelay in src/ws/backoff.ts do? Two or three sentences is plenty.
notes: Fails without the spoken-reply instruction: models answer in markdown and never add the block.

pattern: ordinary question with replies not read aloud
experience: The <speak> convention must stay invisible when nobody is listening.
prompt: What does reconnectDelay in src/ws/backoff.ts do? Two or three sentences is plenty.
